best_for: Aspiring video editors looking for agency-level workflows
YouTubers wanting to increase their production value
Content creators shifting from mobile to desktop editing
not_for: Individuals wanting to edit strictly on their phones
Those who only want to learn 3D animation
target_audience.who_should_take_foundation_first: Absolute beginners with no computer literacy or understanding of digital files.

prerequisites.required: Basic computer literacy and file management skills.
prerequisites.recommended: Familiarity with consuming digital video content.

system_requirements.hardware: Multi-core processor (Intel i5/M1 or better), 16GB RAM minimum, Dedicated GPU (4GB VRAM), Fast SSD for media cache.
system_requirements.software_accounts: Adobe Premiere Pro, Adobe Audition, DaVinci Resolve (Free or Studio).

overview.positioning: The complete pathway to becoming a highly paid, professional video editor.
overview.short_description: Master non-linear editing, color grading, audio mixing, and multi-cam workflows using Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve.

key_facts.ai_integration: AI transcription, auto-reframing, and dialogue isolation

what_you_will_be_able_to_do: Edit narrative and documentary sequences efficiently
Color correct and color grade Log footage
Manage massive media bins and proxy workflows

why_now.industry_shift: The creator economy and digital marketing boom has created unprecedented demand for high-retention, high-quality video editing.
why_now.ai_impact: AI handles tedious tasks like syncing and transcription, allowing editors to focus entirely on pacing, story, and emotion.
why_now.business_demand: Every brand, agency, and influencer needs a dedicated editor to scale their content output.
why_now.career_opportunity: Skilled editors who understand story structure and retention metrics can command top-tier freelance rates.

learning_outcomes: CUT: Master timeline mechanics, J/L cuts, and ripple editing in Premiere Pro.
COLOR: Achieve cinematic looks using Lumetri Color and DaVinci Resolve nodes.
MIX: Clean up dialogue and design immersive soundscapes in Audition.
DELIVER: Export optimal codecs for YouTube, Broadcast, and Social Media.

stages.focus: Premiere Pro fundamentals, pacing, and timeline management.
Color correction, grading, and visual effects.
Dialogue cleanup, sound design, and mixing.
Advanced workflows, multi-cam, and finalizing the capstone.

core_tools.what_student_learns: Trimming, pacing, multi-cam editing, Lumetri color.
core_tools.what_student_builds: Narrative short scenes, interviews, and commercials.
Cinematic color grades on raw footage.

supporting_tools.purpose: Basic dynamic link integrations and lower thirds.

industry_workflow.overview: Professional post-production pipeline from ingest to delivery.

stages.name: Ingest & Organization
stages.desc: Offloading media, creating proxies, and organizing bins.

stages.name: Assembly & Rough Cut
stages.desc: Laying down the story spine and syncing multi-cam angles.

stages.name: Fine Cut & Pacing
stages.desc: Tightening edits, adding J/L cuts, and refining rhythm.

stages.name: Picture Lock & Color
stages.desc: Color correction and grading in Lumetri or Resolve.

stages.name: Audio Mix & Export
stages.desc: Sound design, dialogue leveling, and final media export.

business_use_cases.approach: Fast-paced editing with text graphics and sound design.

business_use_cases.business_problem: Hours of interview footage need to be condensed into a compelling story.

ai_integration.ai_can_assist_with: Transcribing interviews, removing silence, and matching color across clips.
ai_integration.ai_can_automate: Reframing 16:9 to 9:16, generating subtitles, and basic dialogue enhancement.
ai_integration.ai_cannot_replace: Emotional pacing, comedic timing, and narrative structure.
ai_integration.human_expertise_required: Knowing when to hold a shot for emotional impact.
ai_integration.validation_protocol: Manually reviewing AI-generated captions for spelling errors.
ai_integration.responsible_use: Using AI voice enhancement without making the subject sound robotic.

best_practices: Always use a standardized folder structure (Footage, Audio, Graphics, Exports).
Edit using keyboard shortcuts (Q, W, C, V) rather than the mouse.
Use proxy workflows for high-resolution 4K/8K footage.

common_mistakes.why_it_happens: Cutting exactly on the beat every time creates a predictable, boring rhythm.
common_mistakes.professional_approach: Cut on the action, and let the music support the cut.
Ensure dialogue sits at -6dB to -12dB and music is ducked underneath.

career_paths.employer_expectations: A portfolio demonstrating storytelling ability, clean audio, and good color.
career_paths.what_student_demonstrates: A polished editing reel showing various styles (narrative, promo, interview).

freelance_applications.client_workflow: Brief -> Rough Cut (Frame.io) -> Revision -> Picture Lock -> Final Delivery
freelance_applications.portfolio_requirements: 3 distinct video projects hosted on Vimeo/YouTube or a personal website.

what_you_will_build: A color-graded music video or cinematic sequence
final_deliverables: A 1-2 minute editing showreel highlighting your best cuts.
Completed project files and exported MP4s.

assessment.criteria: Narrative flow, pacing, audio clarity, and color consistency.

certification.title: Nova Certified Professional Video Editor
certification.criteria: Completion of all module projects and passing grade on Capstone Edit.
certification.verification: Digital badge and verifiable certificate ID.

not_covered: Advanced VFX compositing, 3D modeling, and live broadcast switching.

faq.question: Can I edit on a Mac and PC?
faq.answer: Yes, Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve work on both operating systems.

faq.question: Do I need to buy footage?
faq.answer: No, we provide high-quality, raw practice footage for all projects.

faq.question: What is the difference between Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve?
faq.answer: Premiere is the industry standard for non-linear editing and integration with Adobe, while Resolve is the industry standard for color grading.

modules.module_title: Premiere Pro Fundamentals & The Rough Cut
modules.module_purpose: Master the Premiere Pro interface and the foundational techniques of non-linear editing.

lessons.what_is_taught: Interface layout, standard folder structures, importing media, and creating proxies.
lessons.why_it_matters: A messy project leads to missing files and extremely slow editing.
lessons.what_learner_does: Organizes provided raw footage and creates a proxy workflow for 4K media.
lessons.expected_outcome: An optimized, organized Premiere Pro project.

lessons.what_is_taught: Source monitor usage, setting In/Out points, and laying down the A-roll spine.
lessons.why_it_matters: The first step in crafting the narrative structure without worrying about polish.
lessons.what_learner_does: Assembles a 2-minute interview sequence from raw takes.
lessons.expected_outcome: A cohesive, logical rough cut of an interview.

lessons.what_is_taught: Using the ripple edit, roll edit, and slip tools to tighten the edit.
lessons.why_it_matters: Pacing dictates the emotion of the scene; these tools make adjusting pace fast.
lessons.what_learner_does: Tightens the interview cut, removing dead space and awkward pauses.

lessons.lesson_title: J & L Cuts for Seamless Flow
lessons.what_is_taught: Detaching audio and video to create overlapping edits (J/L cuts).
lessons.why_it_matters: Hides the cut and makes conversations feel natural rather than rigid.
lessons.what_learner_does: Applies J and L cuts to a two-person dialogue scene.

modules.hands_on_practice: Edit a narrative dialogue scene from provided short film footage.
modules.business_application: Cutting narrative films, commercials, and YouTube content.
modules.expected_outcome: Solid grasp of timeline mechanics and storytelling pacing.

modules.module_purpose: Enhance the story using supplementary footage, dynamic transitions, and basic compositing.

lessons.what_is_taught: Layering video on V2/V3 to cover jump cuts and illustrate the narrative.
lessons.why_it_matters: B-roll keeps the viewer engaged and visually explains the A-roll.
lessons.what_learner_does: Adds B-roll to the previously edited interview sequence.

lessons.what_is_taught: Keyframing speed to create slow-motion to fast-motion transitions.
lessons.why_it_matters: A highly popular technique in sports, automotive, and music video editing.
lessons.what_learner_does: Creates a stylized montage using 60fps/120fps footage.

lessons.what_is_taught: Using MOGRTs (Motion Graphics Templates) for titles and lower thirds.
lessons.why_it_matters: Adds professional branding and context without leaving Premiere.
lessons.what_learner_does: Customizes and applies lower thirds and a title sequence.
lessons.expected_outcome: A branded video ready for broadcast or YouTube.

lessons.what_is_taught: Using Ultra Key, masking, and tracking basic objects.
lessons.why_it_matters: Essential for corporate shoots, gaming videos, and basic VFX.
lessons.what_learner_does: Keys out a green screen subject and places them in a new environment.
lessons.expected_outcome: A clean, believable green screen composite.

modules.hands_on_practice: Edit a high-energy promotional montage with speed ramps and titles.
modules.business_application: Product promos, music videos, and social media ads.
modules.expected_outcome: Ability to craft visually engaging sequences beyond simple cuts.

modules.module_purpose: Achieve broadcast-quality sound by mastering dialogue, music, and sound effects.

lessons.lesson_title: The Audio Track Mixer & Essential Sound
lessons.what_is_taught: Reading waveforms, setting levels, and using the Essential Sound panel.
lessons.why_it_matters: Bad audio ruins good video; proper levels are non-negotiable.
lessons.what_learner_does: Balances the audio levels of dialogue, music, and SFX tracks.
lessons.expected_outcome: A balanced mix peaking at appropriate broadcast levels.

lessons.what_is_taught: Removing rumble/hiss using EQ, and evening out volume using dynamics compression.
lessons.why_it_matters: Makes voices sound rich, clear, and professional, like a podcast or broadcast.
lessons.what_learner_does: Processes raw, noisy dialogue into a crisp, clean voiceover.

lessons.what_is_taught: Layering ambient sound, Foley, whooshes, and hits.
lessons.why_it_matters: Sound design creates immersion and sells the visual edits.
lessons.what_learner_does: Builds a complete soundscape for a silent cinematic sequence.

lessons.what_is_taught: Sending clips to Audition, using the spectral frequency display, and noise reduction.
lessons.why_it_matters: Audition provides surgical tools for rescuing bad audio that Premiere cannot fix.
lessons.what_learner_does: Removes a siren and background hum from an interview clip.

modules.hands_on_practice: Perform a complete sound design and mix pass on a provided short film scene.
modules.business_application: Podcast editing, film mixing, and commercial audio finishing.
modules.expected_outcome: Proficiency in turning raw audio into a professional mix.

modules.module_purpose: Transform the visual tone of your footage using industry-standard color workflows.

lessons.what_is_taught: Using Waveforms and Vectorscopes to balance exposure and white balance.
lessons.why_it_matters: You cannot trust your eyes or monitor alone; scopes provide objective data.
lessons.what_learner_does: Neutralizes and matches multiple mismatched shots in a sequence.

lessons.lesson_title: Color Grading & Cinematic Looks in Premiere
lessons.what_is_taught: Using Lumetri Color curves, color wheels, and applying/modifying LUTs.
lessons.why_it_matters: Grading establishes the mood and cinematic feel of the video.
lessons.what_learner_does: Applies a 'teal and orange' blockbuster grade to a scene.

lessons.what_is_taught: Isolating specific colors (like skin or skies) using HSL qualifiers and masks.
lessons.why_it_matters: Ensures human subjects look natural even under heavy stylized grades.
lessons.what_learner_does: Isolates and perfects skin tones while changing the background color.
lessons.expected_outcome: A professional grade with flawless skin tones.

lessons.what_is_taught: XML round-tripping from Premiere, node-based grading, and power windows.
lessons.why_it_matters: Resolve is the industry standard for high-end color grading.
lessons.what_learner_does: Exports an XML from Premiere, grades it using nodes in Resolve, and renders it back.
lessons.expected_outcome: A high-end color graded sequence utilizing Resolve's power.

modules.hands_on_practice: Color correct and grade a music video sequence.
modules.business_application: Freelance color grading and finishing high-end commercial projects.
modules.expected_outcome: Ability to confidently correct and grade raw/log footage.
